bars.says: At colony zoom and sound, the player sees a crusted plain of low leaning fuzz, taller vine obstacles and occasional ancient tree landmarks, and can distinguish ordinary wind, a quiet Stall and a driven Gale.

meant.intent: This is the actual place, not just an arid biome label. Knee-height is a relative canopy read: people stand above it, small animals occupy it, vines interrupt human sightlines and trees rise beyond both. Art quality/variant counts are not acceptance gates. Reject inference: losing these contrasts loses the compose sentence and OWNER integral-vine/wind directions. First-version: land.

accept: A person stands above the moving cover; a small native disappears behind ordinary foliage rather than becoming magically invisible; the vine mass interrupts the person’s view.
Calm makes the wind bed subside; a Gale drives dust along the plants’ shared lean while the map and route warnings remain readable. A tree-free map still reads as Scrub.
reject: A silver recolor of open sand leaves people hidden by tall ordinary grass, and the Gale is a motionless fog sheet with the ordinary wind audio still playing.
A tree’s oversized canopy obscures every route warning at colony zoom, or noisy jungle calls drown out the Stall.

accept: The weather progresses on its own; routine work and deliberate trips remain distinguishable, new runners approach wild margins, animals feed and mature, and the same colony resumes its unfinished jobs and claims after loading.

Changing the order of gathering, route clearing, tree harvest and claim placement changes local outcomes without duplicating resources or stranding routine work; the long claim eventually pays its recorded due reward.

TACCOUNT: resource identity, fractions, reservations, due ticks, full-stack/placement failure, repeated harvest, death, off and reload; reject corrupted event streams. Fake bridge harnesses test their own assertions, not production behavior.

Current source candidate target0.15/cap0.22, clearance30, armed growth0.5 and strict0.8/1.0/1.5 size edges; sweep min/default/max. Tune these freely to the route experience; neither target share nor a room count is a passing bar.

Agent provisional default120 days/range120–600 frozen per current claim, candidate cane2 wood-equivalents/heat1.25; verify adapter conservation and mixed-fuel bookkeeping, not declaring numbers a reason to refuse.

Resolve actual disease HediffDef/mechanism from the composed game before adapters; candidate refreshed nonstacking one-day condition,250-tick pulse,0.01 normalized severity reduction per eligible condition, zero/off control. Check immunity/natural recovery separately. No guessed health def names.

No roster eviction; parse effective base and campaign animals, body stages/diets/products/flight data and multi-home rows. A native water or ordinary-hatch failure is substantive evidence for ordinary_life, not permission to delete the native.

RM_LeaningScrub_Biome.xml currently maps low fertility to Sand and selects RM_ScrubDryThunderstorm; latter actually carries WeatherEvent_LightningStrike. TTERRAIN must resolve crust/soil and remove natural ignition while preserving the requested wind. Anomaly monolith/overcast weather eligibility is swept; no DLC-absent tier.

At all default producers (wild plant regrowth, island room/crown heart, incident, jobgiver, ritual/meme/research/menu and campaign patch), next-version plant forms/products/jobs/letters/incidents absent. Existing animal species remain. Assert default OFF and ON characterization per ticket.

Verify actual active flight intervals/jobs/landing, frame prefix/frame availability, launch/home fallback and cancellation from pure production tracker receipts. No forced launch and no unattended flight visual test.

Whole-run observer (ticket TWHOLE) records gates/unlocked weather, living IDs, growth/claim inventory, power, completed jobs, error rate and actual save identity throughout15 days plus due extension. Performance readings are current-state evidence; no invented TPS target is a bar.
Existing guardian/farmer-camp/drying-scar/legacy-preservation cuts stay excluded; do not ask again. No worldgen additions or cross-biome guarantees.

Model reports safe-route upkeep labor versus available work at3/40 colonists, usable work completion, hunger and path replan stalls. Investigate any sustained maintenance consuming all available work. Initial diagnostic budget<one colonist-equivalent per ordinary route is a guess for tuning, not a passing threshold.

rules.rule: delegated: Only the census kept fates run by default. Next-version source and defs remain, but producers, discoverability, jobs, letters, incidents and effects are gated OFF. Existing animal rosters remain; extra plant forms are suppressed at all spawn paths. A kept caller of a pure helper does not retain its deferred effect. Universal floor is settings/load/clean log/current-schema reload, never old-save migration. Master/all-off cancels mod jobs safely, releases reservations and owned objects with a sign; it blocks new effects and preserves recorded current claims/banks without paying them. Reenable performs at most the already-earned pending transactions. No global engine switch hides a local extra.

delegated: Sun elevation and bearing come only from the actual authored tile and shared CreatureBehaviors geometry; Direct Sun uses the shared roof/parasols/tree geometry, not a Scrub heat field. Continuous downwind vector serves creep and overlay; plant sprites use the nearest east/west lean and north/south ties east, per the recorded sun-snap direction. Land is low cover and crust/soil without open sand; native living plants resist easy ignition; no rain or autonomous lightning ignition. Preserve a windy overcast/storm twin if needed for the later weather instruction but remove its damaging ignition event, never infer a new natural-fire permission from a wind request.

delegated: Retain ordinary windy twins, Stall calm and Gale stronger wind, not scripted hearing disease, turbine surge/breakdowns, raid weight, scent or directed fire. Useful power follows vanilla WindManager/circuit/storage. No private supply floor during Stall. Natural/native sound is subdued posture and movement; remove jungle voice beds inconsistent with the quiet-wild sheet while retaining wind.

delegated: Only slow creep advances kept stands. Kept thicket, Dripping and Hollow count explicitly; no Walking jumps or tail cane. Use initial map open-ground denominator D0 saved at placement, and count current vine cells for the cap so later roofs/zones do not raise allowed occupancy. Exempt kept vines from ExplosiveGrowth everyday band and soaking, while ordinary growth of other plants stays on. Fresh runners remain unarmed until the shared threshold. Stop at cap without killing existing stands or animals. A cap below existing occupancy suspends growth rather than removing life.

delegated: Use EnvironmentalHazards strict body-size greater-than blocking. Current free/body block bands are thicket/Dripping 0.8/1.5 and Hollow 1.0/1.5; at 1.5 a pawn is not blocked solely by size, though venom can make the route unsafe. Armed threshold current growth 0.5 applies consistently to contact and warning; Hollow has no contact venom, not an invisible tunnel/teleport/crawl job. Intrinsic thornhold melee remains a distinct damage cause. No shared-engine redesign or global disable.

delegated: An ordinary player work job cannot authorize expected harmful contact even if no safe route exists. Use an explicit expedition UI acknowledgement tied to actor ID, job ID and target; discard on job finish, cancellation, retarget, down/death or mental break. Across current reload validate the same unfinished actor/job/target and recompute the route; a stale/missing link gives no permission. Drafting alone is not blanket consent. Check route at planning and before entering newly armed cells; wait/replan with a readable reason. Rescue/firefighting/food work cannot silently inherit consent. Physical size barriers still apply to explicit orders. Animal and emergency forced-movement limits are documented separately, not used as hidden ordinary-work exceptions.

delegated: Developed ground is a cell under a roof, an existing building, a laid floor/underterrain, a zone or a sown plant. No creep insertion there; a designation alone and Home area alone are not immunity. Dirt routes are actually cut/harvested and checked as maintenance; no invisible dirt-route ward. Plans/blueprints do not clear a pre-existing vine; the construction job waits for safe explicit clearing. Blocking a natural bottleneck cannot make ordinary poison crossing legal.

delegated: Blanket is consumed only on completed placement; claim captures stand ID, growth/yield basis, start and duration/due, never reads a new duration retroactively. Banked claim stops creep and reproduction but is not a safe passage until actually removed; remaining contact hazard is labelled. On completion outside Plant.TickLong replace it once, place actual output before removing custody record, and retry boundedly if placement fails. Destroyed stand loses that claim with readable cause; cancellation before completion costs no blanket. Mature claims held while off pay once on reenable; no legacy conversion. Default120 engine days, range120–600 are provisional check tuning. Supply: current recipe requires FuzzFiber and SweetlineWool; add an explicitly labelled ordinary Cloth substitute so tree-free maps can use legitimate traded/grown-under-cover cloth. No guaranteed merchant or free ingredients.

delegated: Premium cane uses a verified per-fuel consumer adapter, not filter membership. Conserve mixed-fuel credit and actual useful consumer output; provisional 2 wood-equivalent fuel units/cane and 1.25 heat rate are checks only. UI lists supported consumers; unsupported mods receive ordinary fuel or reject it with that fact visible, never claim premium. Ordinary Dripping harvest uses vanilla regrowing-harvest completion, no unearned venom from canceled jobs.

delegated: Eligible rubbers are living spawned animals with a ready shearable coat, no rope, and a reachable legal tree touch-cell inside pen/allowed-area constraints. At successful completion consume only that coat; divide into ground wool and conserved felt fraction with visible cap overflow (drop the overflow as wool, do not duplicate or silently erase it). Bank payout debits only delivered whole units, preserves fraction. Once-mature free shedding survives harvest. Healing is a nonstacking self condition refreshed only by completed rubbing, never by proximity; adapters cover ordinary animal flu/plague and muscle/gut parasites, clamp normalized severity, do not edit immunity or injuries. Unrecognized disease mechanism remains untreated and readable. No instant cure, resurrection, permanent-condition cure or coatless hospital service; ordinary medicine remains useful. Death/tree destruction/interruption cannot complete a canceled rub.

delegated: Keep the effective base/campaign animal roster and ordinary lifecycle products. No species eviction to meet the size ladder; note a conflicting adult band or multi-home for the existing human review instead. No new large-band residents. Native environmental water counts for its natives through the shared behavior, never drinking-water safety for colonists. Distinguish ordinary predation/decay/map exit from silent deletion; record corpse, exit or other readable sign. No custom den, ambush, corpse rolling, wet-ground, limb drop or exclusive grazer engine at default.

delegated: Every fiction flyer uses genuine Pawn_FlightTracker state and whole-body directional animation. Retain shirrel Gale launch/home/return as locomotion; detach dustflutter and any other flyer’s basic flight from crown/bloom dependency. On tree loss, off/interruption or wind change safely land and resume ordinary behavior; never vanish. Only owner-attended visual flight tests; unattended proof is non-mutating tracker/state analysis and never drives a flyer. Deferred Surrik burrowing stays off locally without disabling shared flight or sun.

delegated: All deciding traces use current composed-build/defs/settings fingerprints and all kept mechanics active. Mutation/direct proof hooks characterize a seam only, never demonstrate natural generation or autonomous choice. The whole bar runs unlocked natural weather for a season and continues to claim due; acceleration preserves every production interval, event order and save identity. Read-only observers do not inject decisions. Metrics and thresholds are attackable checks; a red regression alone is not a refusal.

meetings.why: One tile geometry supplies sun and downwind; visual east/west snap is explicitly an approximation, never fed back as the physical vector. Low fuzz and tall-vine navigation are compatible because only the latter interrupt human sightlines. Terrain/ignition conflicts are implementation tickets, not an invented second sun. Whole-season dynamics are covered by the other shared-state meetings.

Calm duration, wind-fed storage, real flight/home return and worker demand can combine to starve work even when their isolated state checks pass. Model actual transition timing, not a weighted-average wind value.
Start clearance, reachable safe topology, cap denominator and new growth may jointly seal the only exit or remove grazing. Pairwise clearance/cap checks cannot exclude a sealed channel later.

Vine replacement reduces forage, ordinary predation changes coats/prey, tree care changes illness and reproduction, and real flight changes reachability. A model must expose starving or exploding populations without relying on deferred bloom, invisibility, lures or fire stamping.
Rare/no tree, shedders, animal coats, care, bank harvest and blanket supply meet. The imported Cloth route breaks a logical no-tree deadlock but availability/labor and duplication remain unmeasured.

Scheduler/event order, current-schema rehydration, population/food and maintenance feedback with every kept mechanic on have not been observed together. The model selects worst regimes; only the whole bar’s live continuation can settle runtime integration.
Maintenance, food production, cloth supply, power and job retries draw from the same labor budget; each can pass alone while the colony stalls.

Job purpose, shared size/contact gates, tree access, due-claim hazards and changing cover must agree at planning AND the next cell; a saved token can make several otherwise-valid systems unsafe together.

Wool division, harvest, claim replacement, premium fuel and death/interruption can lose or duplicate resources via scheduling and reload. All rewards and losses require a single identity ledger, including visible overflow.
